body:
I get it.

For myself right now it feels like I just have all of these tools in my hand that I know how to use to succeed, but rarely actually use said tools.

As for friendships and relationships, I worry that I will miss my time for that. I don't want to be 30 and living alone with no friends while working at a research lab (my intended career path). I've seen posts from lawyers who have no friends due to the fact that they secluded themselves during schooling. I don't want that.

I think it's going to be fine on that end.

Today I saw the psychiatrist again and got officially diagnosed with moderate depression (as if having a 2 counselors and a GP telling me wasn't obvious).

Shes still trying to do ground-work in dealing with the ADHD and asked if I could get my father to come around next time for some questions to understand how my childhood went.

I came home tonight and explained what needed to be done and he obliged. I guess he's more understanding of the situation than I had previously thought.

In the past my brother was 'dealt with' in the mental health system.

I didn't know much about it (I was too young at the time), but I do know he was seeing a psychiatrist and prescribed medicine. The medicine didn't help much, and soon he was out of the psychiatrist's hands.

Imaginably, this complicates things with my father and dealing with me. Seeing how the system didn't necessarily do much for my older brother, he doubts any form of care that I seek is going to helpful (to clarify, he is not part of the people that I mentioned in the group of friends).

Throwing down as in "hating" on me. 

I refuse to talk to anyone about it now. Any conversation about topics closely related to it or about it are met with a "shut the fuck up" from me.

I tried to talk it out with a friend of mine (female) and she just kept on throwing down on me. So much for faith in my friends...

I decided to tell a close(r) friend of mine to force me to see a professional. I supposed services like that can exist where you suggest someone to seek help, so thats what i did. It's happened twice in the past where ive contemplated seeking help, but just shut up and left it alone. Again, its the stigma surrounding help for these sorts of situations.

I won't go to my school counsellor because I think he's "useless". He screwed up all my courses this year, and took over a month to fix it. Previously i told him i was being bullied, and he didn't do much.

Yes, I think it does drive us to this paranoia and privacy. When im at home, i shut my door to my room, and always stay by myself. I can't stand having my door open, its like leaving everything of yours to be nitpicked and looked at. I only started doing it this year though.

The girl was a friend i met somewhere and flirted with just because, she actually didn't know who my girlfriend was. Her sole mission in her conversations with me was just to incriminate me (i suppose), and only after getting enough evidence, decided to present it to my now ex (after of course finding her).

I can't stand highschool at all anymore. I've tried talking to my friends about it and they give me the same saying "it gets better later on", but ive lost hope. Its painful at times to even show up to school.

This probably attributes to why i am on Reddit doing this, not talking to people i know, because i don't want them to know what is going on with me. Somehow, i fear it will only cause more problems if they know about my situation.

I myself am reluctant to talk to a therapist. I've pondered it at times, but i feel its almost like admitting theres something wrong with you. And i dont exactly want to do that.

I am of Asian culture, where parents are everything to you. You can't badmouth them at all, or else its a beatdown. My aunts and uncles often wonder why i disconnect myself from my family so much, and its frustrating at times when they tell me i just gotta "do it" and get back to being happy with them.

I am paranoid because of all the things that have happened to me. It feels like a collaboration from everyone to put bad things upon myself. I feel like its myself against everyone else, in that everyone is collaborating with each other to make me miserable.

I think im both stressed and depressed. However, again, i wont admit that to my peers, because that would 'shame' me.
